title: Milk thistle tincture for liver support
subtitle: A long-course tincture of Silybum marianum seed for liver health and recovery
excerpt: Milk thistle tincture is a 1:5 extract of dried, ground Silybum marianum seed in 60% spirit, taken daily over 8 to 12 weeks. Traditionally used in European herbal practice for liver recovery after alcohol excess, medication load, or chronic digestive stress. The silymarin complex in the seed is the best-studied hepatoprotective constituent in herbal medicine, with clinical trial data in chronic liver disease. A 100 ml bottle holds about 20 doses at 5 ml and keeps two years.

glossaryTerms.definition: The group of flavonolignan compounds extracted from milk thistle seed that are responsible for its hepatoprotective effects. Silymarin protects liver cells from oxidative damage and supports their regeneration. It is the best-studied hepatoprotective plant constituent in herbal medicine.
Protecting the liver from damage or supporting its recovery and regenerative function. Used of herbs and compounds that reduce oxidative stress in liver cells.

content.text: Milk thistle herbal extract is a 1:5 extract of freshly ground Silybum marianum seed macerating in 60% spirit for 4 to 6 weeks. The seed's
complex, a group of flavonolignans, gives it a strong

action with more clinical evidence behind it than most herbal preparations. Traditionally prepared for liver recovery after periods of alcohol excess, high pharmaceutical medication load, or chronic digestive stress. The herbal extract is pale yellow-beige with a mild, slightly bitter taste. Taken consistently for 8 to 12 weeks.

attrs.title: Precautions
attrs.body: Not medical advice. Consult a qualified herbalist or doctor before use. Full precautions are in the 'When not to use' section.

items.prepNote: dried milk thistle seeds, freshly ground
60% ABV spirit, or use 3 parts 40% vodka to 1 part food-grade alcohol to approximate 60%

content.text: Grind 20 g of dried milk thistle seeds in a coffee grinder to a coarse powder. The silymarin content is higher in freshly ground seed than in pre-ground.
Transfer to a clean steeping jar. Pour 100 ml of 60% spirit over the ground seed. Stir to combine. Seal and label with the date.
Store in a cool dark place for 4 to 6 weeks, shaking daily. The liquid will become pale yellow-beige.
Strain through doubled muslin into a dark glass bottle, pressing the seed mass thoroughly. Label and store in a cool dark cupboard.
3 to 5 ml in a small glass of water, three times daily before meals. A consistent 8 to 12 week course. Take a 4-week break before repeating.
Sealed dark glass bottle in a cool dark cupboard. Keeps two years from the date of straining.
When not to use this remedy

Do not use for liver disease without medical supervision. See a doctor for jaundice, upper right abdominal pain, nausea with fatigue, or unexplained weight loss, these need diagnosis. Milk thistle is a supportive herb for a functioning liver, not a treatment for liver failure.
